newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco fuel oil price down 4.7 pct in December.
newsitem.headline: Morocco fuel oil price down 4.7 pct in December.

text.p: The fuel oil price on the Moroccan market was set at 1,618.10 dirhams ($188) per tonne for December, down 4.7 percent from November, the energy ministry said in its monthly bulletin on Monday.
The price in November was 1,698.72 dirhams per tonne, the ministry said.
"The price change was due to a slight fall of prices on the international market between October 28 and November 27, 1996," it added.
Other refined products such as gas oil and diesel were unchanged, the ministry said.
Morocco's energy imports, including crude oil, reached 10.2 million tonnes, mainly from Gulf countries, at a cost of $1.2 billion, in 1995.
